planes.role: Deterministically generate, crosswalk and validate machine-readable research corpora.
Operate the software-engineering intelligence application over bounded source-tree and Git observations.
Execute exact-scope test protocols and retain evidence without self-certifying independence or qualification.
Optional independently versioned Python provider distributions for exact abstract contract editions.

allowed_python_roles: Research source models, builders, crosswalks and fail-closed validators
Application-domain services and experiences for codebase engineering intelligence
Deterministic pure method implementations where numeric and resource contracts are explicit
Qualification, differential, property, metamorphic and failure-injection harnesses
Notebook or exploratory experiences when their outputs remain proposals until admitted

package_split_triggers.trigger: A method is claimed reusable outside codebase intelligence.
package_split_triggers.required_action: Extract an editioned abstract contract and application-neutral test vectors before moving code into a separately versioned provider package.

package_split_triggers.trigger: A module acquires provider SDK, network, storage or process effects.
package_split_triggers.required_action: Separate pure contract/value semantics from the effectful provider adapter and bind resource, failure, retry, cancellation and evidence behavior.

package_split_triggers.trigger: A horizontal product needs Python implementation.
package_split_triggers.required_action: Create a product-owned package only after product boundary and library authority are ratified; do not enlarge shannon_insight as a miscellaneous platform container.

package_split_triggers.trigger: A second implementation or non-Python runtime is selected.
package_split_triggers.required_action: Use canonical carriers, shared conformance vectors and differential/exit evidence; do not treat Python object serialization as the interoperability contract.

interchange_laws: Canonical carriers are editioned and language-neutral.
Private admitted values are reconstructed only after validation of hostile carriers.
Provider-specific handles remain outside abstract semantic contracts.
Unknown fields, versions, partiality, time and loss behavior are explicit.
Cross-language equality and digest rules are declared before portability is claimed.
current_package_actions: Keep distribution name shannon-codebase-insight and import facade shannon_insight.
Classify every current module under the application boundary.
Expose cross-layer dependency debt rather than pretending the package is already cleanly decomposed.
Prevent runtime imports from research authority corpora.
Require exact contract and qualification references before any module is promoted as a reusable horizontal implementation.
